'''Watchdog''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|remote combat platform]] created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as [[the Unmasked]] to guard their [[Unmasked research station|research station]] in [[Unmasked research station|Sector R-4]]. It was created, in part, using the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] product known as [[nihrot]] and with the assistance of [[ARIA (AI)|AIRA]], an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]]. It was destroyed by the [[Alliance Commander]] during the [[mission to the R-4 anomaly]] and it's remains were likely destroyed when the station exploded.<ref name="operation" />
